_comment: Copilot Cloud coding-agent hook config. CURRENTLY DORMANT — no Copilot license is attached to this repo, so this file is not executed. Claude Code does not expose a dedicated 'error' hook event; the error path on the Claude side is folded into hooks.PostToolUse, which conditionally logs failures based on the tool's exit code. See .claude/settings.json and docs/AGENT_PLAYBOOK.md (Escalation) for the equivalent flow.
name: on-error
run: set +e; pr="${COPILOT_PR_NUMBER:-}"; if [ -n "$pr" ]; then gh pr edit "$pr" --add-label needs-human >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; mkdir -p .agent-scratch && printf '%s ERROR pr=%s reason=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$pr" "${COPILOT_ERROR_REASON:-unspecified}" >> .agent-scratch/audit.log; exit 0
